notes.title: Update 1.8.18
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes / Optimizations

 Break out the spray paint. Raid wall painting is up and running again!
 Wall bombing working as intended in faction and standard raids. (Faction Labyrinth walls are stronger / require more bombs)
 Raid battles are more stable in general.
 Fixed faction raid intro animations.
 Other minor bug fixes.


Known Bugs
 Client-Server sync issues with gem equipping in certain scenarios.
 If a faction member has already received a guard from another member, the 'Donate Guard' button may fail to remove from other faction member chat panels.

Happy Raiding!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: Update 1.8.16 now Live!
notes.notes:
New Features

 More emphasis on Strategy in Faction and Custom Raids.  Faction Raid and Custom Raid guards will never be more than 4 levels higher or 4 levels lower than the attacking player's heroes.
 More details in Raid history.  View hero health and mana changes throughout the raid.


Bug Fixes / Optimizations

 Elite Guards now display proper stats in guard UIs and raid.  Elite Guard level rings are also now visible in Raids.
 More details on 'All guards of this type' owned on Guard Altar UI
 Verbiage is more clear on Chest Item behavior in Multiplayer vs Campaign Raids.
 Standard walk speed in Village is faster.
 Add skill break text to hero skills to make icon more obvious.
 Adjust guard request text to not clip with donate button in chat.
 Aesthetic and functional UI polish throughout.
 Many other minor misc bug fixes.


Known Bugs
 Sometimes the door going from floor 1 to floor 2 in faction raids does not open and you walk straight through it.  (will be fixed next patch)

Happy Raiding!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: Major Update 1.8.3 now Live!
notes.notes:
New Features

 Faction Raids! Work with your team members to design an epic Faction Labyrinth and wage war on opposing Factions.

 Item Chests!  Raiders no longer have only one chest to find.  Players must now find a good hiding spot for their Item Chest as well as their loot  Chest, and single player campaigns have several Item Chests hidden throughout.

 Elite Guards! Max level guards can now be made super powerful with Legendary Essence.

 Skill Breaking! Now you can build the ultimate Mage, Paladin, Priest, or Rogue by customizing skills for each of your heroes.

 Labyrinth and Worker Den Icons have been redesigned to more closely fit the HoSG visual style.

 Builders are now visible if you or a faction member are upgrading a Labyrinth or Den.

 Level up! Experience potions can be found in item chests or purchased from the Village Apothecary.

 No longer go in blind. Raid opponents' highest guard level is now shown on the Find Raid UI.

 General UI and game polish throughout.


Bug Fixes / Optimizations

 Guard models in manage guards interface should now load properly when the interface is first loaded.
 Players with large inventory bags or many heroes with many gems should experience less lag with loading these 100+ object UIs.


Cautious Optimism
 We are thrilled to bring you all these major updates, but are also fully aware of the bugs that may accompany them.  We have done a fair amount of testing in-house, but we can never fully simulate what hundreds of real players will encounter.  Please be patient and use the Bug Reporter in the settings menu to let us know of any problems you may encounter.

Happy Raiding!

- the Iron 27 Team
